findings.issue: The glossary freezes Ovate = أوفيت and its note names this exact string: "named NPC + title of address (ST_Core_NpcNames/Ovate, Ovate's Chamber); name, so transliterated". العَرّاف translates the word as 'the soothsayer', so the fast-travel point no longer carries the character's name.

الأسير is already the Arabic for The Captive, a named boss (LandingArea_Boss_Sword 'Captive's End' = منتهى الأسير, Dialogue_Dlg_CaptiveBossDefeated = الأسير). Rendering the generic 'Prisoner' with the same word makes this road read as the Captive's, and it sits on the same boss run-up.

'Flooded Village' (ST_Core_Dungeons/LI_Tomb_Medium_Layout_15) is also القرية الغارقة. Two distinct locations now carry one Arabic name, which breaks navigation and map labels. Sunken (submerged/collapsed into the ground) and Flooded (water-covered) need separating.
Third occurrence of the Conqueror split — الفاتح here and in Conquerer's Rise / Conqueror's Reward, but الغازي in the boss-defeated line. Needs one sweep across all four.
Second location using المُريد for the generic 'disciple'; المُريد is frozen as Acolyte, Tiel's title.
أعرج means lame/limping, not one-legged. The tavern sign's joke is the missing leg, and the count is the whole image.
